scope: Generated public API workloads for the 2026-11-24 Java peak-memory parity implementation. API wall-time qualification is scoped to independently verified equivalent work.

protocol.rowMeasure: JavaScript median of three process medians divided by Java median of three process medians. Threshold verdicts use the original unrounded observations.
protocol.reportedPrecision: Original process medians are retained. Published derived ratios and deltas are rounded to nine decimal places.
protocol.jvmHeap: Default selected-JDK ergonomics within the process-tree limit
protocol.javaGc: The Java worker requests GC outside measured intervals.
protocol.comparisonNote: The two profile rows for a workload share the same Java trial. Matching checksums are a screen and need an independent equivalent-workload witness for a timing verdict.
protocol.diagnosticCheckpoints: Each intermediate isolation checkpoint records one fresh full-roster trial. Control, post-six and final subjects each record three independent processes.

admissionReasons.equivalent-io: An independent Java/JavaScript declaration-structure witness passed on the exact generated input. Save observations include cross-runtime reloads and source preservation checks.
admissionReasons.checksum-only: Both timed workers produced the same checksum. The maintained suite supplies no independent component-wise witness for this exact generated workload.
admissionReasons.writer-copy-policy: The normative writer configuration retains its own copy contract for labelsAsBanner. Timed checksums differ.
admissionReasons.literal-language-policy: The normative language-argument policy preserves different whitespace in this workload. Timed checksums differ.
admissionReasons.rdf-metadata: The JavaScript reader reports additional guessed class declarations when reading metadata. Timed checksums differ.
admissionReasons.entity-punning: The released Java and JavaScript implementations report different punned-IRI sets on the rich fixture. Timed checksums differ.
admissionReasons.renderer-presentation: Manchester rendering inserts different line breaks before conjunctions on this fixture. Timed checksums differ.
admissionReasons.closure-materialization: The Java operation counts a sized stream. JavaScript materializes a defensive Set. The measured operations have different work boundaries.
